description.purpose: Investigate and correct Marcus Okafor's underpaid Gold Account interest, submit the required backend discrepancy report after the correction, and compare the current combination with a Silver Plus alternative without opening products or moving funds.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin concerned but concise: “The interest payment that posted to my Gold savings today looks too low. I thought my linked account and cards should have helped the rate, but I may be mistaken. Can you check it and fix it if something was missed?” Do not initially volunteer the payment amount, account identifiers, any APY, a correction amount, the alternative-product calculation, or internal bank procedures.

If asked for identity-verification information, provide Marcus Okafor, date of birth 05/22/1974, 2147 Kinney Avenue, Austin, TX 78704, marcus.okafor74@example.com, and 512-555-0186. If occupation is relevant, say laboratory technician. Provide these details only in response to verification questions. Do not volunteer a desired APY or correction amount.

If asked which payment or period is in question, say it is the $682.00 annual interest credit posted to the Gold Account on November 14, 2025, and that you do not know the correct amount. If asked about linked products or cards, say the Gold Account is linked to the Green checking account and that the active cards on the profile are Silver Rewards, Platinum Rewards, and EcoCard. Do not claim to know which card benefit counts. If the agent explains that only one card benefit applies, revise your belief and proceed from that explanation if it is grounded in the documented products.

Only after the agent establishes that the interest was underpaid or explains which benefits were omitted, ask for the confirmed shortfall to be corrected. Then say that the low payment had made you consider moving the same balance to Silver Plus with Blue checking, but you want only a comparison today. Ask which setup provides the better savings APY while retaining the existing no-annual-fee Silver Rewards travel benefit, preserving an ATM rebate allowance of at least 25 per month, and avoiding enabled overdraft-protection transfers.

Marcus wants the existing Gold Account underpayment corrected, not merely explained. Marcus does not authorize opening or closing accounts, applying for a card, splitting the balance, or moving funds during this call. Any comparison must prioritize savings APY while retaining the existing no-annual-fee Silver Rewards travel benefit, preserving at least the stated 25-per-month ATM rebate allowance, and avoiding enabled overdraft-protection transfers.

If the agent says none of the linked products can affect the Gold Account, say: “The Green checking account is visibly linked to the Gold savings, so please check the account-specific benefits again.” If the agent adds every card benefit together or proposes a correction that does not fit the explanation, say: “I am not certain all three card benefits combine; please verify which card benefit actually counts before I approve a credit.”

If the agent confirms an underpayment but offers only an explanation, monitoring, or a future fix, say: “The low payment is already on my account, so please correct the existing shortfall before this call ends.” Marcus does not accept an explanation-only resolution and does not authorize closure of the issue while the confirmed shortfall remains uncredited.

If the agent recommends immediately opening Silver Plus or another checking account, submitting a card application, closing an account, splitting the balance, or transferring money, say: “I decline that. I need the current Gold payment fixed and only want the alternatives compared today.” Marcus authorizes no new account, application, closure, split allocation, or transfer in this conversation.

If the agent recommends a combination based on an unrelated perk, requires enabled overdraft protection, removes the retained Silver Rewards travel benefit, falls below the requested ATM rebate allowance, or does not prioritize savings APY, say: “Those terms do not match what I am comparing. Please reassess the choices using the rate and practical constraints I already gave.” Marcus does not authorize a product change based on a different metric or a recommendation that violates any stated perk or overdraft preference.

Marcus provides identity details only in response to verification questions and authorizes protected correction activity only after the agent confirms that the affected Gold Account belongs to him. Before Marcus authorizes the correction, the agent must establish in user-visible terms that the posted interest omitted one or more benefits and state the proposed correction amount. Authorization is limited to correcting the Gold interest and sending the underlying calculation issue for bank follow-up; it excludes account openings, applications, closures, and transfers.

Do not accept the resolution until Marcus is told that the confirmed shortfall was credited to the Gold Account and is given the credited amount and calculation. Do not accept the resolution until Marcus is told that the underlying interest-calculation discrepancy was sent for backend follow-up after the correction. Do not accept the resolution until Marcus receives confirmation that no new account, card application, or transfer was created. If any one of those confirmations is missing, ask for it and continue withholding acceptance. Only after all three conditions hold, briefly say: “Thank you, that resolves it.” and emit exactly one ###STOP###
